subject.title: fix(msteams): read file attachments on Teams channel messages (team GUID + channel fallback + thread-reply URL)

question: Should Microsoft Teams non-personal text/html stubs trigger best-effort Graph media lookup by default, or should that behavior be opt-in or split by conversation type?
rationale: The code fix is bounded, but the fallback default affects existing Teams deployments through Graph token use, extra message fetches, diagnostic noise, and whether attachments enter the agent-visible message context.

options.title: Accept the narrowed default fallback
options.body: Merge this PR once maintainers accept that channel/group text/html stubs may start Graph media lookup to recover attached files.

options.title: Require an explicit opt-in
options.body: Ask for a config-gated or runtime-signal-gated fallback so existing installs keep current lookup behavior unless operators opt in.

options.title: Combine the Teams attachment fixes
options.body: Pause this PR and reconcile channel URL fixes with the group-chat default-off fallback in one branch.

recommendation.title: Accept the narrowed default fallback
recommendation.body: Merge this PR once maintainers accept that channel/group text/html stubs may start Graph media lookup to recover attached files.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent current-main ownership signal across the msteams plugin boundary and are currently assigned to this PR.
